LIFE ABOVE THE CITY

The city outside.
Space of your own.

Approximately 53.80 m² of private terrace wraps around two sides of the apartment. There is room to sit outside, share a meal and watch the light change across the rooftops.

Large windows and terrace doors connect the interior with this outdoor space. Potsdamer Platz is the setting for both.

Your own corner

An eighth-floor, top-floor home at Potsdamer Platz with a large wrap-around terrace. AVAILABLE NOW · OFFERS WELCOME

A rare opportunity
at Potsdamer Platz.

We’ve called this apartment home for almost four years. Now there’s an opportunity to enquire about taking it over immediately.

A furnished takeover may also be possible, including the washer, dryer, TV and other household essentials. Availability, exact contents and any furniture or appliance takeover price are to be agreed separately from the rent.

Enquire now about a takeover, or wait until January 2027 to join the viewing queue. Final arrangements and rental terms remain to be confirmed with MVMG.

About the area figures

The original plan states 83.67 m² Wohnfläche. The room areas total approximately 70.22 m² indoors; the stated Wohnfläche is consistent with including 25% of the 53.80 m² terrace. The full terrace area is not additional indoor living space.

Figures are taken from the supplied plan dated 13 November 1998 and should be verified. The private shared hallway off the lift is separate from the entrance hall shown inside the apartment.
